title: Self-attention is a Dyson equation for many-body machine learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.21398v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Why does symmetric sum-pooling (DeepSets) predict ground-state potentials to sub-meV accuracy, yet fail for correlated wavefunctions and excited states? Sum-pooling is a mean-field (Hartree) model: its $O(1/N)$ off-diagonal Jacobian suffices for nearsighted ground-state energies, but erases nonlocal two-body correlations. We show that self-attention is a real-space Dyson iteration whose Boltzmann (softmax) kernel acts as a two-body self-energy. Because physical Hamiltonians act pairwise, L\"owdin's 2-RDM theorem and the Galitskii--Migdal relation guarantee that iterating a two-body propagator captures the full energetics of correlated matter. When fitting a fractal backflow determinant, DeepSets blurs the nodal surface onto a mean-field envelope, whereas self-attention recovers the fractal attractor. translated_title: 自注意力是多体机器学习中的戴森方程
translated_abstract: 为什么对称求和池化能够以亚毫电子伏特（sub-meV）的精度预测基态势能面，却在处理关联波函数和激发态时失效？求和池化是一种平均场（Hartree）模型：其 O(1/N) 的非对角雅可比矩阵足以应对具有近视性质的基态能量，但会抹除非局域的二体关联。我们证明，自注意力机制本质上是一种实空间中的戴森迭代，其玻尔兹曼（softmax）核充当二体自能。由于物理哈密顿量以成对方式作用，Löwdin 的二体约化密度矩阵（2-RDM）定理与 Galitskii-Migdal 关系保证了二体传播子的迭代能够捕捉关联物质的全部能量学信息。在拟合分形回流行列式时，DeepSets 会将节点面模糊为平均场包络，而自注意力则能恢复分形吸引子。透过这一视角来看，注意力机制的非凡有效性并非偶然；在一个由成对相互作用构建的宇宙中……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文证明自注意力机制等价于实空间中的戴森方程迭代，其softmax核充当二体自能，因而能够完整捕捉关联物质中的二体相互作用，从而从物理原理上解释了注意力机制在多体机器学习中“不合理有效性”的根源。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that self-attention is a real-space Dyson iteration whose Boltzmann (softmax) kernel acts as a two-body self-energy, so it captures the full energetics of correlated matter and explains the unreasonable effectiveness of attention in many-body machine learning.
